title: Underground cities built before the Younger Dryas to survive catastrophe

tellings.quote: I believe that those were built well over 10,000 years ago over I mean they had to to me they had to have been built before the younger dras catastrophes

plain: The underground cities of Cappadocia in Turkey were built well over 10,000 years ago, before the Younger Dryas, a sudden cold period that some link to global catastrophes, according to the researcher Matt LaCroix. LaCroix tells Michels this as his own belief, without naming a source, saying they "had to have been built" before those disasters. If true, it would mean people dug them to survive the catastrophe.
